lines: Having moved away from the plaza, Astaroth and the refugee brothers had made their way through the back alleys, where there were no people to see them, and finally reached the furthest part of Yomihara.
Older Brother
「We've arrived, Astaroth-san.」
Younger Brother
「That guy should be here at this hour, too......」
Astaroth
「What is this place?」
What towered over their eyes was a remarkably impressive mansion.
No more buildings could be seen behind it, and it seemed like they had come to the edge of Yomihara.
Older Brother
「This place is called the Greed House.」
Older Brother
「It's a shrine to pleasure, that deals in money, women, drugs, everything.」
Astaroth
「Hmmmm.」
Despite asking, Astaroth didn't seem all that interested.
For her, the only question was whether she would be able to meet a strong person if she set fire to this place.
Younger Brother
「They say the leader who sold our little brother hangs out here, with the money he's sponged off of putting the refugees to work.」
Older Brother
「The facility's money probably flows to Nomad, too, so that means it's a symbol of our enemies, in a manner of speaking. If we're gonna wreck the place, this is where to start......!」
A symbol of black money, the riches of Yomihara. Which meant this establishment was undoubtedly fitting as a target of their destruction.
Astaroth
「But, won't you also be in danger, this deep underground? Well, I'll be fine, though♪」
Younger Brother
「We don't care! Our lives are just gonna be exploited if we stay silent.」
Younger Brother
「In which case, we're gonna strike back against them with one single blow, and die gloriously!」
Astaroth
「Fuuh...... I struggle to comprehend what weak men think.」
Astaroth
「Though I don't dislike the dying gloriously part♪ Let's go inside right away.」
Surprisingly, the three of them had been able to easily enter the Greed House without being stopped.
They were even received with cries of 「Welcome!」 Was it because of Astaroth's captivating beauty and Hellish aristocrat air?
They were walking around, looking for the room where the leader of the refugees was, when they came out into a large hall.
It was lavishly furnished, probably used for parties or something, but right now it appeared to be uninhabited.
Astaroth
「Rather nice taste, I see. I don't dislike this furniture♪ It looks like it would be worth burning......♪」
Younger Brother
「Ah, Astaroth-san! If you stare too hard, they're gonna suspect something, y'know?!」
Astaroth
「Oh, it's better to be bold with this sort of thing.」
「What are you doing, Onee-san and friends?」
Suddenly, an innocent-sounding voice rang out in the vast room.
Felicia
「Saying something about burning just now......」
What appeared was a young girl, who even seemed childlike.
Older Brother
「Wh-Wh-What's that, ya brat?!」
Younger Brother
「Wh-Wh-Who-Who d'ya think Astaroth Nee-san is?!」
The girl was smiling fearlessly, not faltering at all in spite of being glared at by the brothers.
Astaroth
「You...... You're fairly strong, aren't you?」
Felicia
「Looks like Onee-san is someone who “gets it”.」
Only Astaroth had sensed the girl's power.
The girl also appeared to have instantly discerned that Astaroth was no ordinary person.
Felicia
「Out of respect for Onee-san, Felly could turn a blind eye, okay?」
Astaroth
「My, how impertinent♪ That's my line, you know?」
An unusual air of tension ran through the empty hall.
Daunted by that atmosphere, the refugee brothers were completely shaken.
Older Brother
「Uh, Astaroth-san, if she says she'll let us go, why don't we take her up on that and move on......?」
Younger Brother
「Right. There's a kinda dangerous vibe......」
Felicia
「Ahaha! Onee-san's servants are funny!」
The girl made a high-pitched laugh, whereupon
Felicia
「I'm not going to overlook you after all! Play with Felly!!」
Forming a wicked expression on her face, she raised her scythe and charged towards them.
